comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront category page.
modal: Turns the **PayPal Pay Later** (Bill Me Later) promotional banner on or off on the **category** page. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the PayPal Pay Later banner is shown on the storefront home page.
modal: Turns the **PayPal Pay Later** (Bill Me Later) promotional banner on or off on the **home** page. Can be set per website.

comment: Turns PayPal Pay Later promotional banners on or off across the storefront.
modal: Master switch for advertising **PayPal Pay Later** messaging. When **Yes**, the Pay Later banners configured for each page are eligible to show. Can be set per website.

comment: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the shopping cart page.
modal: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the **flex**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the cart page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is **flex**. Can be set per website.

comment: Position of the PayPal logo within the Pay Later text banner on the category page.
modal: Where the PayPal logo sits within the **text**-layout Pay Later banner on the category page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout and a primary/alternative logo type. Can be set per website.

comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the category page.
modal: Sets the text size of the **text**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the category page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

comment: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step.
modal: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the **flex**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the checkout payment step. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is **flex**. Can be set per website.

comment: Position of the PayPal logo within the Pay Later text banner on the home page.
modal: Where the PayPal logo sits within the **text**-layout Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout and a primary/alternative logo type. Can be set per website.

comment: Text size of the PayPal Pay Later text banner on the home page.
modal: Sets the text size of the **text**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the home page. Applies only when that banner is displayed with a text style layout. Can be set per website.

comment: Aspect ratio of the flex-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the product page.
modal: Chooses the aspect ratio/size of the **flex**-layout PayPal Pay Later banner on the catalog product page. Applies only when that banner is displayed and its style layout is **flex**. Can be set per website.

comment: Display order of PayPal Credit relative to other payment methods at checkout.
modal: Sets the position of **PayPal Credit** among the available payment methods at checkout (lower numbers appear first). Applies only when Express Checkout PayPal Credit is enabled.

comment: Country used to simulate the buyer's location when testing Express Checkout in sandbox mode.
modal: Selects a buyer country, from the country list, to emulate during **sandbox** testing of PayPal Express Checkout. Applies only when sandbox mode is enabled. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether PayPal Express Checkout applies to all allowed countries or only specific ones.
modal: Chooses whether PayPal Express Checkout is offered to **all allowed countries** or only to a **specific** list of countries (set in the related country field). Can be set per website.

comment: Whether individual cart line items are sent to PayPal for billing-agreement orders.
modal: When **Yes**, each cart line item (name, quantity, price) is transferred to PayPal rather than only the order total, for PayPal Billing Agreement transactions. Can be set per website.

comment: Brazil installment period shown on the PayPal button on the cart page.
modal: Selects the Brazil installment period displayed on the PayPal Smart Button when the cart-page button label is set to installment. The option list is PayPal-specific. Can be set per store view.

comment: Corner shape of the PayPal Smart Payment Button on the checkout page.
modal: Sets the shape of the PayPal **Smart Button** rendered on the checkout page. Applies only when checkout-page button customization is enabled. Can be set per store view.

comment: Corner shape of the PayPal Smart Payment Button in the mini cart.
modal: Sets the shape of the PayPal **Smart Button** rendered in the mini cart. Applies only when checkout-page and mini-cart button customization are enabled. Can be set per store view.

comment: Corner shape of the PayPal Smart Payment Button on product pages.
modal: Sets the shape of the PayPal **Smart Button** rendered on product pages. Applies only when checkout-page and product-page button customization are enabled. Can be set per store view.

comment: Whether settlement reports are fetched from PayPal's sandbox server instead of the live one.
modal: When **Yes**, PayPal settlement reports are retrieved from the **sandbox** (test) SFTP server rather than the production server. Can be set per website.

comment: Display order of PayPal Express Checkout among payment methods at checkout.
modal: Sets the position of PayPal Express Checkout in the list of payment methods at checkout (lower numbers appear first). Can be set per store view.

comment: The Payflow Partner ID that identifies your PayPal/Payflow account to the gateway.
modal: The **Partner** value supplied by PayPal or an authorized reseller that identifies the Payflow Link account when connecting to the gateway. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the payment is only authorized, or authorized and captured, when the order is placed.
modal: Chooses how funds are handled when an order is placed via Payflow Express — typically **Authorization** (hold funds for later capture) or **Sale** (authorize and capture immediately). Can be set per website.

comment: Display order of Payflow Express Checkout among payment methods at checkout.
modal: Sets the position of Payflow Express Checkout in the list of payment methods at checkout (lower numbers appear first). Can be set per store view.

comment: Whether customers must enter the card security code (CVV) at checkout.
modal: When **Yes**, the card's CVV/CSC must be entered at checkout. Applies only when CVV editing is enabled. Can be set per website.

comment: The specific countries from which Payflow Link payments are accepted.
modal: Selects the countries allowed to use Payflow Link. Applies only when 'Payment Applicable From' is set to specific countries. Multiple countries can be chosen; can be set per website.

comment: Whether the payment is only authorized, or authorized and captured, when the order is placed.
modal: Chooses how funds are handled for PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution orders — typically **Authorization** (hold funds for later capture) or **Sale** (authorize and capture immediately). Can be set per website.
basis: group:Basic Settings - PayPal Payments Pro Hosted Solution

comment: Whether PayPal's SSL certificate is verified on gateway API calls.
modal: When **Yes**, the SSL/TLS certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified when the gateway connects (recommended). Can be set per website.

comment: The Payflow Partner ID that identifies your PayPal Payflow Pro account to the gateway.
modal: The **Partner** value supplied by PayPal or an authorized reseller that identifies the Payflow Pro account when connecting to the gateway. Can be set per website.

comment: The Payflow Vendor (merchant login) that identifies your PayPal Payflow Pro account.
modal: The **Vendor** value — your merchant login created with PayPal — used to authenticate Payflow Pro gateway requests. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether to reject the transaction when the card issuer is located outside the United States.
modal: Part of the AVS fraud checks: when **Yes**, a transaction is rejected if the card's issuing bank is outside the United States. Can be set per website.

comment: Country used to simulate the buyer's location when testing in sandbox mode.
modal: Selects a buyer country, from the country list, to emulate during **sandbox** testing of Payments Advanced / Express Checkout. Applies only when sandbox mode is enabled. Can be set per website.

comment: The Payflow Vendor (merchant login) that identifies your Payments Advanced account.
modal: The **Vendor** value — your merchant login created with PayPal — used to authenticate Payments Advanced gateway requests. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether PayPal sends the buyer an email confirmation for the transaction.
modal: When **Yes**, PayPal (Payments Advanced) sends an order/payment confirmation email to the buyer. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether PayPal's SSL certificate is verified on gateway API calls.
modal: When **Yes**, the SSL/TLS certificate of PayPal's endpoint is verified when the gateway connects (recommended). Can be set per website.
